en: Burgh waits at the far end of the hall. His Bug types are tough, but Fire, Flying and Rock moves hit them hard!
Hey there, future champ! Welcome to the Castelia Gym. Burgh's taste in decoration is... sticky. Mind the honey!
Burgh's Bug types fold to Fire, Flying and Rock moves. Here, have a drink before you start!
You beat Burgh! Your battle was a work of art. I might even ask him to paint it!
Welcome! I've just got back from the sewers, and do you know what? My muse came back with me!
I'm Burgh, Leader of this Gym and painter of Bug Pokémon. I'll paint our battle onto the canvas of your memory!
Oh ho... You're strong, all right. I suppose losing was no surprise. Here, the Insect Badge! I think it suits you!
{player} received the Insect Badge from Burgh!
And, well, have this too. Take it as thanks for the inspiration!
The Insect Badge looks even better on you than I imagined. Route 4 is north of the plaza, through the gate. Off you go!
Your Pokémon and you painted something wonderful together. Come back and show me how you've grown!
